needed_streams: An independent measurement correlated with the Core_mid zone to distinguish a genuine thermal rise from a faulty sensor. Candidates (none currently exposed in the store): (a) room-level Air_Temperature_Sensor values for rooms in Zone_F3_Z01 (e.g., Room_F3_R001..R008) — if they do not rise with the zone sensor, the zone sensor is faulty; if they track it, a real load change is indicated. (b) CO2_Sensor / Occupancy_Sensor for Zone_F3_Z01 — a change in occupancy/CVAD would corroborate a local load change. (c) Plug/Electric_power or Lighting sensor for the zone, or VAV damper-position / supply-air flow and setpoint for Zone_F3_Z01, to confirm a change in loads or HVAC delivery rather than a sensor fault.

content.text: The store only contains zone air temperature sensors and setpoints; there is no independent data (room-level temperatures, occupancy, plug power, CO₂) that could corroborate vs refute the Core_mid reading. With only a single temperature stream per zone, a genuine local-load rise and a local sensor drift/fault are indistinguishable.

input.needed_streams: An independent measurement correlated with the Core_mid zone to distinguish a genuine thermal rise from a faulty sensor. Candidates (none currently exposed in the store): (a) room-level Air_Temperature_Sensor values for rooms in Zone_F3_Z01 (e.g., Room_F3_R001..R008) — if they do not rise with the zone sensor, the zone sensor is faulty; if they track it, a real load change is indicated. (b) CO2_Sensor / Occupancy_Sensor for Zone_F3_Z01 — a change in occupancy/CVAD would corroborate a local load change. (c) Plug/Electric_power or Lighting sensor for the zone, or VAV damper-position / supply-air flow and setpoint for Zone_F3_Z01, to confirm a change in loads or HVAC delivery rather than a sensor fault.
